content: In India, always carry small denominations of cash (₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100) for auto-rickshaws and street vendors, as they often don't have change for ₹500 notes.
Use prepaid taxi counters at airports and railway stations to avoid being overcharged by touts. Uber and Ola are also reliable in major cities.
Mumbai: The best time to visit Marine Drive is at sunset. Try the street food at Girgaum Chowpatty, specifically Pav Bhaji and Bhel Puri.
Goa: North Goa (Baga, Calangute) is great for nightlife and parties, while South Goa (Palolem, Agonda) is better for a quiet, relaxing beach vacation.
Jaipur: Visit the Amer Fort early in the morning (around 8 AM) to avoid the crowds and the midday heat. Don't miss the Lassi at Lassiwala on MI Road.
Drink bottled or filtered water only. Avoid tap water and ice cubes in street drinks to prevent stomach issues.
Kerala: A houseboat stay in Alleppey is a must-do. Book an overnight stay to experience the backwaters at sunrise and sunset.
Delhi: The Lotus Temple is closed on Mondays. Chandni Chowk is best explored on a cycle rickshaw.
